# GoldAlert
GoldAlert (https://goldalert.org/) is a free educational precious-metals dashboard with 31 articles. It combines provider-supplied live market context with scheduled daily closes used for transparent pullback signals, commodity dashboards and macro ratios.

## Core signal rule
- 0–2 consecutive lower daily closes: HOLD
- 3–4 consecutive lower daily closes: 50% BUY / WATCH
- 5 or more consecutive lower daily closes: 100% BUY / STRONG

These labels are rule stages, not probabilities, forecasts or individualized position-size recommendations.

## Primary pages
- / — gold and silver tools, charts, signal board, backtests, watchlist and price alerts
- /market/ — live precious-metals context, daily technical summaries, gold news and a US economic calendar
- /tools/gold-calculator/ — gold value estimate by weight, purity, currency and premium
- /commodities/ — daily WTI oil, natural gas, copper and platinum context
- /ratios/ — Gold/Silver, Gold/Oil, Bitcoin/Gold, Gold/Copper and Gold/Platinum ratios
- /embed/ — free gold and silver iframe widget builder
- /articles.html — complete educational article index
- /methodology.html — calculation rules, sources, limitations and version history
- /privacy.html — browser storage, analytics, advertising and third-party disclosures


## Editorial scope
